title: fix: show all community model categories
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Derives community tabs from categories present in the loaded catalog
- Keeps a category when switching scopes only when it exists in the target catalog
- Accepts community video, audio, and embedding category URLs
- Adds focused category tests

gist.headline: Every shelf in the hive
gist.blurb: The community model catalog now lets all its shelves exist. Video, audio, and embedding models have stopped hiding behind a slightly overprotective tab bar.
gist.summary: Fixed the model catalog so community tabs are derived from the loaded catalog, preserve only categories available in the selected scope, and accept direct community video, audio, and embedding category URLs.
gist.impact: People browsing community models can now reliably find video, audio, and embedding categories, including when opening a focused category link or switching catalog scopes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a cozy librarian bee with tiny round glasses, opening a warm lime-green community model library where previously tucked-away shelves are clearly labeled Video, Audio, and Embeddings. Include a happy CRT monitor robot pointing at the newly visible shelves, with code-plants and small flowers growing between the bookcase compartments to represent a catalog that adapts to what is actually available.
